confirmed.cause: local_event_repository.dispatch observes no local target while holding the actual event lock, releases it and invokes original. A genuine private bootstrap can persist binding before the original legacy writer obtains its own lock. Original save_state then mutates positive legacy storage without another binding check. SQLite needs the binding check inside the same write transaction, not merely under one instance's Python lock.
confirmed.inventory: 36 named public writers exist in each backend. Memory mark_event_handled currently has no lock and no mutation; include it in the explicit fence inventory rather than invent a mutation. Several SQLite methods already BEGIN IMMEDIATE; others have only an implicit DML transaction or delegate to *_locked helpers.
